reference.title: Message status
reference.shortdesc: Each message in a chat shows where it is on its way to the other phone.

property.propdesc: On its way to a phone that is nearby now.

proptype.msgph: Will send when you're together again

property.propdesc: Waiting until you're close again with the app open on both phones. A waiting message is kept for up to 30 days.
The match faded before the message could be delivered.

proptype.msgph: Not sent. You weren't together for 30 days.

property.propdesc: The message waited 30 days without your phones meeting.
